Plot person-specific time series

Source: R/stats_plot_describe.R
plot_series.Rd

One panel per person, showing one or more variables over time. Variables are distinguished by line type as well as colour. A horizontal reference marks zero, which is the person's own mean after person-centring or decomposition with preprocess_panel().

Usage

plot_series(
  data,
  id,
  time,
  vars,
  subject = NULL,
  reference = c("zero", "mean", "none"),
  ...
)

Arguments

data

Long-format data frame.

id

Person identifier column.

time

Column giving the order of occasions.

vars

Variables to draw.

subject

Persons to draw; defaults to the first person in data.

reference

Horizontal reference line: "zero", "mean" (each variable's mean for that person), or "none".

...

Ignored.

Value

Invisibly, the plotted rows (one row per person and occasion).

Examples

prepared <- preprocess_panel(srl, id = "name", time = "day",
                             vars = "efficacy", decompose = TRUE)
plot_series(prepared, id = "name", time = "day", vars = "efficacy_within",
            subject = "Aisha")
